ledger.title: guestLinkedEmail now rejects where it resolved null, shipped as a minor bump
ledger.disposition: Withdrawn by the reviewer: The rejection holds. The finding itself conceded the fix is consumer-side. The package is pinned by git SHA, so nothing picks up 11.5.0 without an explicit repin PR. The README documents the reject-on-unknown contract, and `src/guestAuth.linkedEmail.test.ts` pins it. The author reports that the only consumer caller, in shore, already has a rejection arm, which I did not re-check because consumers are off-limits.
